records.title: Trophische Beziehungen erklären
records.description: Die lernende Person kann Nahrungsnetze, Energiefluss und Populationsdynamik beschreiben.
records.subject: biologie
records.aiNotes: Branching meadow food web shows food to consumer, solar input to plant and outgoing heat from plant and every consumer. No energy-return cycle or universal numerical transfer efficiency is pictured. Grass/grasshopper/frog/stork and grass/mouse/stork are coherent representative paths. Decomposers and actual population dynamics remain whole-case/text work; this overview never purports to depict the entire whole competence. At 360 the organisms and all arrow directions stay distinct; Nahrung/Wärme are small auxiliary labels, readable but not required to infer direction from the large arrows. At 680 those labels and every branch are clear. Beide ganzen Alttexte und ganzer nativer PDF-Kontext tatsächlich geprüft. Nur maschinelle QS; keine Human Approval.

records.title: Pflanzliche Anpassungen
records.description: Die lernende Person kann strukturelle Anpassungen von Pflanzen an Umweltfaktoren erläutern.
records.subject: biologie
records.aiNotes: Two conditional dry/wet structural examples distinguish thicker cuticle and sheltered pore from broad thinner leaf. Leaf magnifications remain connected to actual leaves. Blue arrows leave pores and rise from soil towards roots; no inverted transpiration. Tissue is schematic rather than a named microscopic species claim. No claim all wet/dry species share these exact traits. At 360 both blade shapes, thick/thin upper layers and outward pore arrows remain visible. Trocken/Feucht stay readable. At 680 pore opening, cuticle and root-uptake directions are fully separable. Beide ganzen Alttexte und ganzer nativer PDF-Kontext tatsächlich geprüft. Nur maschinelle QS; keine Human Approval.

records.title: Tierische Anpassungen

Both ear/body contrasts, thermoregulation circles and Kalt/Warm remain clear at 360; the vascular inset is recognisable. All three detail classes are distinctly readable at 680. records.title: Ökologische Modelle anwenden
records.description: Die lernende Person kann dynamische Modelle (z.B. Lotka-Volterra) erläutern.
records.subject: biologie
records.aiNotes: Green prey maximum precedes orange predator maximum. Rabbit green arrow ends on green peak; lynx orange arrow ends on orange peak. Bestand is vertical and Zeit horizontal. Modell and external weather arrow signal idealisation and boundary conditions rather than observed census data. Whole common logistic cases and separate BY-EA LV extension were independently read before image context. This schematic is not a universal source-course obligation. At 360 both animals, differently coloured phase-shifted curves, their correctly assigned arrows, axis labels and external influence are clear. At 680 the lynx-to-orange mapping is unequivocal. Earlier v1 captures were not viewed and receive no approval. Beide ganzen Alttexte und ganzer nativer PDF-Kontext tatsächlich geprüft. Nur maschinelle QS; keine Human Approval.

records.aiNotes: Wall bank and vegetated habitat bank contrast a management option, habitat structure and monitoring. Habitat protection arrows and an observing person/checklist show mechanisms and subsequent checking, without guaranteed success. At 360 bank structure, fish/vegetation contrast and the observing person/checklist remain recognisable; Schutz/Ufer/Kontrolle are readable. At 680 habitat features and monitoring are clear. records.title: Torpor und Winterschlaf
records.description: Die lernende Person kann Torpor und Winterschlaf als spezielle Anpassungen erklären.
records.subject: biologie
records.aiNotes: Daily torpor is drawn as one lowered metabolic interval against day/night, seasonal hibernation as longer low baseline with several brief arousal peaks and subsequent spring rise. Stoffwechsel names the ordinate quantity and Zeit labels horizontal time. Temperature symbols show reduction, not a universal exact temperature or continuous ordinary sleep. At 360 both daily/seasonal time strips and reduced metabolism/arousal peaks remain visible and primary Torpor/Winterschlaf labels readable. At 680 chart axes and recurrent peaks are clear; no minute numerical text is required. Beide ganzen Alttexte und ganzer nativer PDF-Kontext tatsächlich geprüft. records.title: Verhaltensanpassungen

records.subject: biologie
records.aiNotes: Courtship, territorial signalling and cooperative parental care are distinct behaviours. Energy-up icons depict costs alongside possible offspring benefits. Heart is a friendly courtship symbol, not asserted evolutionary intent; the actual cases explicitly reject intention and unsupported kin-selection certainty. No displayed data prove a historical adaptive story. At 360 all three behaviours, energy-cost/offspring icons and Balz/Revier/Kooperation remain distinguishable; at 680 whole three-part comparison is clear. Small bird details are decorative rather than assessment text. Beide ganzen Alttexte und ganzer nativer PDF-Kontext tatsächlich geprüft. Nur maschinelle QS; keine Human Approval.
